sentences.en: Korea received an inspection from the International Atomic Energy Agency.
sentences.zh: 韩国接受了国际原子能机构的检查。

sentences.en: After a lengthy inspection, the tunnel was reopened to traffic.
sentences.zh: 经过长时间的检查后，隧道重新对车辆开放。

sentences.en: He is leaving for China on an inspection tour next month.
sentences.zh: 他将于下个月前往中国进行视察访问。
